reason: Free for me sounds fine, but the crew is the one holding my money and the job, and the page leaves blank exactly what happens when a crew stops mid-job. I would not sign a renovation on a pilot that is not even open in Tbilisi yet.
objection: Can the crew run over budget and I have no recourse?
would_change_my_mind: A written answer to what happens if the crew stops mid-job, including who finishes the work and how my stage payments are protected, plus a named Tbilisi crew I can check myself.
